name: The Peninsula Tokyo
positioning: Urban hotel facing the Imperial Palace gardens and Hibiya Park, at the Marunouchi-Ginza edge
best_for: Luxury shoppers and first-time Tokyo visitors

facts.text: About 300 rooms and suites in a 24-storey tower that opened in 2007; it is the only Peninsula hotel in Japan.
Ginza is about a three-minute walk away.
Haneda Airport is about 8.8 miles away (around 40 minutes by airport bus); Narita is about 35.7 miles (around 90 minutes by bus).
Hei Fung Terrace (2nd floor) serves Cantonese cuisine.
Other dining: afternoon tea in The Lobby with live music, and The Peninsula Boutique & Café, known for its mango pudding.
More than 1,000 artworks by about 60 Japanese artists are displayed throughout; the hotel is pet-friendly and has a dog menu.

highlights.text: Address 1-8-1 Yurakucho, Chiyoda-ku, opposite the Imperial Palace gardens and Hibiya Park, with a direct entrance to Hibiya subway station.
Peter, on the top (24th) floor, relaunched on 1 October 2025 as a Modern French restaurant under Chef Yohan Da Costa, with Peter: The Bar alongside.
The hotel has an indoor heated pool of about 20 m and a vitality pool overlooking the Imperial Palace gardens.
The house-car fleet includes Rolls-Royce Phantoms and custom MINI Cooper S Clubmans. The MINIs offer complimentary chauffeured rides for suite guests (up to 3 hours within 10 km).

considerations.text: The hotel is in a dense city-centre business and shopping district (Marunouchi/Yurakucho), not a resort setting. Green space means Hibiya Park and the palace gardens across the street.
Narita is about 90 minutes away by airport bus. Haneda (about 40 minutes) is much more convenient for this hotel.
Peter changed concept in October 2025 (steak and grill to Modern French tasting and à la carte menus). Older reviews describing a steakhouse are out of date.
Palace and park views depend on room category.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily (the standard published rate is room only, with breakfast usually extra).
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers are combinable with the exclusive perks.
